title: Cosmic Dragon Tree
description: A surreal black and white illustration features a glowing blue cosmic tree with swirling vortex rings at its crown, rooted in a dark reflective pond with two small sailboats. A large ornate dragon with floral patterns flows from the tree upward into a starry night sky containing a prominent black hole with blue rings and swirling blue galaxies.
prompt: Surreal fantasy illustration of a majestic white tree with glowing blue concentric rings floating above it, its roots emerging from a dark pond with lily pads and two small white sailboats. A long ornate dragon covered in flowers coils from the tree into the sky, leading toward a large black hole with bright blue accretion disk and swirling spiral galaxies in a starry black night sky.
